label: 2025 FIVB Men's Volleyball World Championship - 21st edition (first 32-team, biennial era)
source: BUILT from cited bytes under WO-VB-2 (PLAN-VB). Capture: Wikipedia edition-page wikitext (action=raw); per-row sources = LIVE volleyballworld.com schedule pages (ids 21062-21125) + FIVB P2 PDFs in provenance; infobox official total 64 == built count. THE FIRST 32-TEAM, BIENNIAL-ERA WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP (8 pools of 4 -> R16 KO; format reform byte-documented from FIVB board minutes citations in-page) and the first hosted in Southeast Asia (Pasay/SM Mall of Asia Arena + Quezon City/Araneta Coliseum; finals all Pasay). FIDELITY: per-team pool points recomputed from set tokens == standings spw/spl for ALL 32 TEAMS across 8 pools. Spine exact. Champions ITALY - 5th title, BACK-TO-BACK (MVP Michieletto, best setter Giannelli, coach De Giorgi) d. first-time finalists Bulgaria 3-1 (Nikolov best scorer 173); Poland bronze; Czechia 4th - their best since independence. UPSET EDITION preserved: defending Olympic champs FRANCE OUT IN POOLS (18th; lost 2-3 to Finland AND 2-3 to Argentina), BRAZIL 17th (first pool exit in decades), Japan 23rd, Iran d. Serbia 15-9-in-the-5th R16; host Philippines' 20-22 extended-fifth heartbreaker vs Iran; NEW STORE-RECORD SET: Bulgaria d. Germany 40-38 in set 1 (78 points). Sep 12-28 2025, Metro Manila.
